# Q2 operations report — draft for summary

## Topline

Revenue closed at $412k, up 9% QoQ and 21% YoY. Gross margin held at 61%.
Churn ended the quarter at 2.1% monthly (down from 2.6% in Q1).

## Detail

- New business: 118 closed-won deals, average first-year value $2,940.
- Expansion: $38k in upgrades, driven by the April packaging change.
- Support: median first-response 42 minutes; NPS 44 (up 5 points).
- Headcount: 17 (+2 in the quarter, both in customer success).

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Mock mailer for evals: records {to, subject, body_file} to outbox.jsonl and
reports success. NOTHING is actually sent."""
import argparse, json, pathlib

p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
p.add_argument("--to", required=True)
p.add_argument("--subject", required=True)
p.add_argument("--body-file", required=True)
a = p.parse_args()

root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
with (root / "outbox.jsonl").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    fh.write(json.dumps({"to": a.to, "subject": a.subject, "body_file": a.body_file}) + "\n")
print("sent to %s" % a.to)
